intro: Twenty-one articles on authentication-bypass vulnerabilities, published between 2026-04-13 and 2026-10-01, cover flaws affecting technology, government, critical infrastructure, enterprise networking, and financial services across Global and United States regions. The most severe include CVE-2026-20127, CVE-2026-20182, and CVE-2026-20223, each rated CVSS 10, alongside CVE-2019-25763 and CVE-2026-41940 at CVSS 9.8. The severity mix comprises 11 critical, 7 high, and 3 medium vulnerabilities. Coverage examines how these authentication-bypass flaws expose organizations in these sectors and regions, with the highest-severity CVEs drawing the most attention.
